title: Vermillion_City
lead_summary:
Vermillion City is a coastal city accessible from Route 6 from the North and Route 11 from the East.
This city contains Vermillion City's Gym, with Lt. Surge as its leader.
The S.S. Anne is currently docked and be boarded with the S.S. Ticket.
